title: Pin the Step 7 declaration in the native physics source identity
summary: The native physics source identity follows imports from the native environment. It reaches robots/randomization.py through omniwalk/env.py, so native training, evaluation and AMP replay bind its hash, and every native pack ships the file. A dependency identity test now names the file, so a change to the declaration cannot reuse a standing identity. No Isaac run has exercised this code.
next: Push the branch and open the PR; then select the declaration on the native command line and record it in the run identity.
reason: A test addition only: no native run, admission result, gate threshold or accepted capability changes.
